season-23-forever-forward.summary: Welcome to Pokémon GO: Forever Forward! In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.

lego-pokemon-go-2026.summary: The Pokémon GO and LEGO Group partnership continues for Trainers in the US, UK, Poland, France, Germany, and Australia! Visit participating LEGO Store locations for raids, a LEGO-themed stamp rally, event stickers, and LEGO Pokémon SMART Play. The LEGO Stores and Pokémon GO event will take place from August 3, 2026 at 10 am to September 30, 2026 at 11 pm.

go-pass-august-2026.summary: The Lucky Trinket returns and Latias soars into GO Pass: August! The GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe for August will be available from August 4, 2026 at 10:00 am to September 8, 2026 at 10:00 am local time.

shadow-giratina-altered-in-shadow-raids-.summary: Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) will make its Shadow Raid debut in Pokémon GO! If you’re lucky you’ll be able to encounter Shiny Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme)! Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) will appear in five-star Shadow Raids every weekend from August 5 to September 8.

10th-anniversary-celebration.summary: Every Trainer can celebrate 10 years of Pokémon GO with a special Mewtwo! The Perfect Mewtwo Timed Research will be available from August 12, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. PDT to September 6, 2026 at 11 pm local time.

water-festival-2026.summary: Arrokuda and Cramorant splash into Pokémon GO during Ultra Unlock: Water Festival! The Ultra Unlock: Water Festival event will take place from August 18, 2026 at 10 am to August 24, 2026 at 8 pm local time.

gbl-forever-forward_great-league_scroll-.summary: The Great League and Scroll Cup: Great League Edition will run from August 18, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. to August 25, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PT. Great League Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter. Scroll Cup: Great League Edition Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter. Only Water-, Fighting-, and Dark-type Pokémon are eligible. The following Pokémon will not be allowed.

lunala-in-5-star-raid-battles-august-202.summary: Lunala will be in five-star raid battles from August 19, 2026 to August 25, 2026. Raid Hours There will also be a Raid Hour featuring Lunala from 6:00 pm to 7:00 pm local time on the following date: August 19

mega-swampert-in-mega-raids-august-2026.summary: Mega Swampert will be in Mega Raids from August 19, 2026 at 6 am to August 25, 2026 at 10 pm local time.

max-mondays-2026-08-24.summary: These Dynamax Pokemon may appear in Max Battles throughout this season. Max Battles will be available from 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time on Mondays. Power Spots will refresh more frequently. Additional Power Spots will be active on Mondays compared to the rest of the week. Max Battles will rotate to feature different Dynamax Pokemon. On August 24, 2026 , the featured Dynamax Pokemon is Hitmontop .

pokemon-xp-2026-worlds.summary: Celebrate PokémonXP and the 2026 Pokémon World Championships in Pokémon GO! The PokémonXP & 2026 Worlds event will take place from August 25, 2026 at 10 am to August 30, 2026 at 8 pm local time. PokémonXP: Tuesday, August 25, at 10:00 a.m. to Friday, August 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. local time. 2026 Pokémon World Championships: Friday, August 28, at 10:00 a.m. to Sunday, August 30, at 8:00 p.m. local time.

gbl-forever-forward_great-league_ultra-l.summary: The Great League, Ultra League, and Master League will run from August 25, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. to September 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PT. Trainers will also receive 4× Stardust from win rewards (this does not include end-of-set rewards). Great League Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter. Ultra League Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter. Master League All Pokémon are eligible.

mega-gyarados-in-mega-raids-august-2026.summary: Mega Gyarados will be in Mega Raids from August 26, 2026 at 6 am to September 8, 2026 at 10 pm local time.

regirock-regice-registeel-in-5-star-raid.summary: Regirock, Regice, and Registeel will be in five-star raid battles from August 26, 2026 to September 8, 2026. Raid Hours There will also be a Raid Hour featuring Regirock, Regice, and Registeel from 6:00 pm to 7:00 pm local time on the following dates: August 26 September 2

raidhour20260826.summary: A Raid Hour featuring Regirock, Regice, and Registeel is scheduled from 6 to 7 pm Local Time. During this hour there will be an increased number of 5-star Raids.

pokemonspotlighthour2026-08-27.summary: Pokémon Spotlight Hour will feature a different Pokémon and special bonus for one hour at 6:00 p.m. local time on Thursday. August 27 : The featured Pokémon is Mankey and the special bonus is 2× Catch Candy .

pokemon-world-championships-2026-timed-r.summary: Get codes for exclusive Timed Research, a Worlds Tee avatar item, and special Pikachu encounters by tuning in to the 2026 Pokémon World Championships and PokémonXP livestreams. Trainers can earn up to five Pokémon GO rewards across the official Pokémon GO broadcast, the Pokémon World Championships finals stream, official co-streamers, and the PokémonXP Pokémon GO panel. Here’s everything you can unlock.

mega-ascension.summary: Signs of an extraordinary mega-powered week are beginning to appear. Join Mega Ascension to prepare for Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale with Mega Raids, Kalos first partner Pokémon, and GO Pass: Mega Finale! The Mega Ascension event will take place from August 31, 2026 at 10 am to September 4, 2026 at 11 pm local time.

gbl-forever-forward_great-league_ultra-l.summary: The Great League, Ultra League, and Master League: Mega Edition will run from September 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. to September 8, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PT. Trainers will also receive 4× Stardust from win rewards (this does not include end-of-set rewards). Great League Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter. Ultra League Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter. Master League: Mega Edition No CP limit. Mega-Evolved Pokémon are allowed.

raidhour20260902.summary: A Raid Hour featuring Regirock, Regice, and Registeel is scheduled from 6 to 7 pm Local Time. During this hour there will be an increased number of 5-star Raids.

pokemon-go-fest-2026-mega-finale.summary: Rally with Trainers around the world for the mega conclusion of Pokémon GO Fest 2026! Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale brings rotating habitats, powerful Mega Raids, and Super Mega Raids featuring Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y. Prepare during the lead-up event Mega Ascension , then join this unticketed worldwide weekend finale. The Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale event will take place from September 5, 2026 at 10 am to September 6, 2026 at 6 pm local time.
